UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_CraftingTieInstructio: Wear compatible glasses, a straw hat or a summer hat. Keep one supported tying material in your main inventory. Consumes one material use and keeps the original item.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_WearableInstructions: Wear in the retainer slot alongside glasses. Protects one compatible untied pair; take off to reuse. Monocles and hats are excluded.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_WearableDurability: Reusable wearable; per-catch durability is not implemented.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_WearableProtection: Worn eyewear retainer is applying the server retention setting.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_CraftClothRetainer: Makes one reusable cloth retainer from two ripped sheets and two uses of twine or thread. Wear with compatible glasses.
UI_B47ANCEDEyewear_CraftLeatherRetainer: Makes one reusable leather retainer from two leather strips, four thread uses and two rubber bands. A sewing needle and scissors are kept.
